seo.title: VagueVase — JUSTCOLORS by Chiara Zhu
seo.description: Discover VagueVase, a modular sculptural vase collection by Chiara Zhu. Preview and reserve the first edition at BIG Milano.

hero.title: Colour takes form.
hero.body: A sculptural vase collection by Chiara Zhu. Preview and reserve the first edition at BIG Milano.
hero.imageAlt: Large orange and magenta VagueVase in a warm 1970s-inspired interior
hero.caption: Lifestyle visualisation based on the first studio prototype.

intro.title: Playful forms. Considered details.
intro.body: A collection designed to bring more colour, personality and joy into everyday life. VagueVase combines a sculptural body with interchangeable floral elements.
intro.imageAlt: Small lilac and blue VagueVase beside an orange typewriter on a wooden desk
intro.caption: Small VagueVase · floral stem composition

collection.title: Same shape. Different moods.
collection.body: Two colour stories, two scales and endless combinations. The first prototypes explore how one graphic language can move from an intimate desk object to a statement piece.
collection.imageAlt: Small and large VagueVase displayed together in a warm mid-century interior

modular.title: Simple elements. More expression.
modular.body: The vase and its floral elements are conceived as a modular system. Stems can be exchanged, rearranged and styled to create a new character for the same object.
modular.imageAlt: Yellow floral stem and blue graphic stem arranged on a travertine surface

story.title: A bold idea takes shape.
story.body: Born from Chiara Zhu’s graphic research, VagueVase translates rhythm, colour and repetition from a two-dimensional drawing into a three-dimensional object. The visible layers and precise colour changes celebrate the digital fabrication process rather than hiding it.
story.imageAlt: Small VagueVase displayed beside its original graphic artwork

prototypes.title: Made to be seen up close.
prototypes.body: These are the first studio-made VagueVase prototypes that will be presented at BIG Milano. Final production details, colours and delivery timing will be confirmed before any purchase commitment.

images.alt: Small and large VagueVase studio prototypes on a black background
images.caption: Small and Large · first studio prototypes

images.alt: Close view of the orange and magenta VagueVase prototype
images.caption: Layered colour and visible 3D-printed texture

preorder.title: Pre-order at BIG Milano.
preorder.body: Be among the first to bring VagueVase into your space. Reserve your preferred version now or meet the collection at BIG Milano.
preorder.disclaimer: No payment now. Your reservation is non-binding: JUSTCOLORS will contact you with the final price, production timing and confirmation before proceeding.

dialog.title: Choose your first edition.
dialog.body: Complete the form to register a non-binding reservation. No payment details will be requested.
dialog.notesPlaceholder: Tell us what interests you, or ask about other colours.
dialog.consentLabel: I agree that JUSTCOLORS may use these details to contact me about this reservation.
dialog.consentError: Please confirm that JUSTCOLORS may contact you about this reservation.
dialog.privacyText: JUSTCOLORS will use the information provided only to manage this non-binding VagueVase reservation and contact you about price, production and availability. Basic technical information is processed in hashed form to prevent abuse of the form. The information will not be sold. You may request access, correction or deletion by writing to chiara.czhu@gmail.com.
